visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of Thai Sweet and Spicy Shrimp, glistening with a thick red sauce and topped with fresh green basil leaves. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the textures of the cooked shrimp and the vibrant sauce. (2) A male character, wearing a light beige shirt and disposable gloves, is shown from the chest down. He pours a red sweet chili sauce from a bottle into a clear glass bowl on a light-colored wooden table. On-screen text identifies ingredients. (3) The character adds various liquids and powders (fish sauce, lemon juice, oyster sauce, sugar, and starch) into the bowl using a metal spoon and small glass containers. He then stirs the mixture vigorously to combine the sauce. (4) Transition to another glass bowl containing several large, raw Thai shrimp. The character sprinkles white pepper and salt over them. His gloved hands are visible as he tosses the shrimp to ensure even seasoning. (5) Cornstarch is added to the seasoned shrimp, and the character continues to toss them. The scene then cuts to the shrimp being placed into a hot, black speckled frying pan. (6) The shrimp are seen sizzling in oil, changing from grey to a bright orange-pink. The character uses black tongs to flip and move them around the pan. Steam rises from the pan. (7) The cooked shrimp are removed from the pan and placed into a glass bowl. The pan still contains some reddish shrimp oil. (8) Minced red shallots, garlic, and chili are added to the hot oil in the pan. The character uses tongs to stir them as they sauté and bubble. (9) The fried shrimp are added back into the pan with the aromatics. The prepared red sauce is poured over the shrimp. (10) Fresh green basil leaves and red chili rings are added to the pan. The character uses a wooden spatula to stir everything together until the sauce thickens and coats the shrimp entirely. (11) The final dish is shown being lifted and plated, with sauce dripping off the shrimp and herbs, against a blurred kitchen background.
